Name: CP-Milk the villagers (Original dialogue)
Author: tanger1213
Description:
Original Mod: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5948

I just used the software to view the dialog text in the DLL and moved them to content.json.
I made some corrections to make sure it works properly.But,I'm bad at english. Maybe will have some statement errors.
I'm sorry about that.

About "eat_out" dialogue: I can see this command in the DLL, but I still don't know how to make it work.  :((
    "eat_out": Now only female NPC have this dialog add command.
     Maybe it doesn't have the function of real installation, but it already contains some dialog content.
      (You can see the "eat_out" original dialog text in the content.json of the optional file : CP-MilkVillagers(Original dialogue)-have eat out.)

因为我的翻译能力实在太差了,所以放弃了制作中文对话...QAQ

Hope this mod can help anyone who want to translate the dialogue. :D

P.s
      If you like English dialog text and don't want to customize unique dialogue,than you don't need to use this mod.(Without it, the original mod also can                          work Perfectly)
     
       This is the first time I upload mod. There may be errors in some descriptions or options.
